contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine, Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, Reece period 17; small chip. Obverse description: [Bust]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them, wreath on vexillum. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 14.6mm, Weight: 1.22gms, die axis: probably 6
